english_description: The game calls itself Ocean II, though its more commonly used in-game name is Star and Moon Legend. It belongs to the classic “ES II” engine family (shared lineage with es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, xo, Wuhan Station, and Legend of the Yellow Emperor's Soul in this project) and was one of the more widely circulated Chinese wuxia MUDs of its era. hymud (Ocean V: Star and Moon Legend) is its independent successor.
